messages:
Aisha (AE): quick sync — LumenOps wants a 3-week POC for contract ingestion + answer retrieval. they asked for success criteria, security checklist status, and a rough pricing estimate. can we align?
Marco (SE): cc @Owen @Priya. first pass: success = 85% top-1 accuracy on contract Q&A (golden set), <250ms p95 on typical queries, and no PII exfil in logs. recommended harness: golden prompts + automated scoring + regression gates.
LumenOps (Customer): adding: must support redaction rule for SSNs and bank acct numbers. SOC2 is required. also need timeline — legal needs questionnaire back by end of week.
Priya (Solutions): noted. for golden set I'm proposing: 200 labeled Q&A pairs (mix of read/extract/rerank), 50 edge-cases (ambiguous clauses), and 30 redaction tests. we can seed from their sample 500 contracts, will anonymize.
Owen (Sales Eng): pricing question: are they expecting Dedicated capacity? they asked about a committed monthly cost vs pay-as-you-go.
Aisha (AE): customer leans enterprise; will sign reserved if latency stable. give two options pls (small reserved pool vs trial hosted).
Marco (SE): harness outline (short):
1) ingest pipeline -> normalize PDFs -> text + metadata
2) seed golden CSV with: id, prompt, expected_answer, rubric_tags
3) run batch eval to compute exact/span F1 + semantic similarity (embedding cosine)
4) regression gate: any drop >5% exact or >3% semantic -> fail

example golden CSV row:
```
id: 00123,prompt:"What is the termination notice period?",expected:"30 days",rubric: exact
```
Scoring snippet (pseudo):
```
score = if (exact_match) then 1.0 else if (fuzzy_similarity>0.85) then 0.8 else 0.0
```
Priya (Solutions): for tooling we'll use the eval harness in our repo + a small adapter to their contract schema. estimate 2 days to wire ingestion, 3 days to label seedset with SME, 2 days to run baseline evaluations. total ~7 working days to baseline.
Riley (Product): note: ensure we test KV cache behavior for repeated clause queries. caching can skew token costs but helps latency — include in acceptance.
Sam (SRE): security blockers: VPC peering required for Private deployment. if they want Hosted we can offer TLS + customer-managed KMS, but SOC2 evidence needs to be attached. @legal-bot do we have the latest SOC2 pack?
legal-bot: uploaded SOC2 Type II summary to the shared drive: https://redwood.example/soc2/LumenOps-pack. questionnaire template (customer-filled) is at https://redwood.example/security/questionnaire-v2.docx
LumenOps (Customer): thanks — we'll review SOC2 doc. we filled the security questionnaire partially and uploaded to your drive. can you confirm redaction flow?
Marco (SE): redaction flow: ingestion -> regex-based redactor (SSN/ACCT) -> model input. we keep original only inside customer's VPC on Private installs. for Hosted we can enable ephemeral storage + customer KMS + redaction-at-ingest. we'll include a test vector set for redaction.
Owen (Sales Eng): pricing options (rough):
- Hosted trial: $0 commit, usage-based ~ $0.015 /k tokens + eval compute. good for 3-week POC.
- Reserved small: $5k/mo commit -> 8x lower token ops, guaranteed capacity for baseline SLA.
I'll formalize in a one-pager.
Aisha (AE): timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week) — ingest + SOC2 confirmation; Week 1 — seed goldens & run baseline; Week 2 — tuning + run acceptance evals; Week 3 — wrap-up, deliver scorecard + demo.
Priya (Solutions): acceptance gate checklist (quick):
- Golden set top-1 >= 85%
- p95 latency <250ms on sample load
- redaction tests pass (0 exposed tokens in outputs)
- security questionnaire items with SAAS answers flagged as "needs on-prem"

Marco (SE): action items: @Priya create goldens template + initial 50 pairs by Tue; @LumenOps share 100 sample contracts by EOD; @Owen send pricing one-pager by tomorrow. I'll prep the eval harness adapter.
LumenOps (Customer): will share sample contracts today. thanks all.
Aisha (AE): ok — moving to ops board. :thumbsup: will update customer-facing SLA and draft POC statement of work.
Sam (SRE): FYI — if they request VPC peering add 2-3 days for network setup.
Riley (Product): small ask — include a short prompt engineering log with every eval run so we can track prompt drift.
Marco (SE): good call. we'll store prompt versions in the harness and snapshot embeddings for regression checks.
Aisha (AE): perfect. next check-in Friday morning.
Owen (Sales Eng): +1. I'll include a dedicated section about quantization/throughput options for cost savings.
legal-bot: reminder: questionnaire due by Friday EOD for contract to proceed.
Aisha (AE): thanks team — closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers pop up.
